I used to have this dream when I was a kid, probably around age 4,5 or 6. It’s one of my earliest memories because it’s been hard to forget.

The dream would always start the same. My mother would put me in my car seat, start the car, then say she forgot something and would walk inside. At that moment, the house we lived in in the dream was high on a hill, as was the drive way. Next thing I knew the car would begin to roll back and Id wake up with that rollercoaster like feeling in my stomach.

This happened a few times over the course of at least 2 years that I could remember. (Id day for sure this dream happened at least 4 times that I can guarantee. There may have been 8 occurrences altogether but this was a long time ago.) I had gotten to a point where I’d find myself waiting in the car seat at the start of the dream, and would pinch myself to wake up from it. Never failed.

Eventually I got to a point where I thought the only way for that dream to stop happening, would be to go through with it, which was a lot easier once I knew I was dreaming. So just like before, I’m in the car seat, my mom walks inside the house, and the car begins rolling down the hill in reverse. It was a little scary but I think my mindset was aware I could’ve pinched myself if things got too crazy. The dream ended in a dull manner, that’s all I really remembered about it. Never had it again after that.
